# VSMECAP
> The VSME value chain cap platform. The cap that stops spreadsheet chaos.
## What is the VSME Value Chain Cap
Under Directive EU 2026/470 (18 Mar 2026) and Regulation EU 2026/1560 Annex II (24 Sep 2026), protected undertakings (<1000 employees and <EUR 450m) cannot be forced to provide beyond VSME Basic B1-B11 own-walls Scope 1+2.
